headline: Energy security: Bangladesh proposes importing gas from Myanmar via pipeline
summary: The government is seeking to boost energy security by exploring options to bring in natural gas from Myanmar through a pipeline.
details: Bangladesh has formally proposed importing natural gas from Myanmar via a pipeline to strengthen the national energy security framework.
The move comes as the country faces ongoing challenges in meeting its domestic gas demand and managing energy shortages.
By utilizing pipeline imports, the government aims to ensure a more stable and cost-effective supply of fuel for power plants and industries.
This proposal is part of a broader strategy to diversify energy sources and reduce reliance on expensive liquid natural gas (LNG) imports.
Officials are currently discussing the technical and diplomatic feasibility of the arrangement with Myanmar authorities.
caption:
Bangladesh is eyeing a pipeline to bring in gas from Myanmar to tackle energy shortages.

Bangladesh has formally proposed importing natural gas from Myanmar via a pipeline to strengthen the national energy security framework.

The move comes as the country faces ongoing challenges in meeting its domestic gas demand and managing energy shortages.

By utilizing pipeline imports, the government aims to ensure a more stable and cost-effective supply of fuel for power plants and industries.

This proposal is part of a broader strategy to diversify energy sources and reduce reliance on expensive liquid natural gas (LNG) imports.

Officials are currently discussing the technical and diplomatic feasibility of the arrangement with Myanmar authorities.

#Bangladesh #Myanmar #EnergySecurity #NaturalGas #EnergyCrisis

Source: Somoy News, Dhaka Tribune

headline_marked: PM [[pledges support for tech startups]] after meeting world champion MIST team
headline: PM pledges support for tech startups after meeting world champion MIST team
summary: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina emphasized that young innovators are the future of Bangladesh, promising government backing for tech entrepreneurs.
details: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina met with the world champion team from the Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST), celebrating their global achievement in technology.
During the meeting, the Prime Minister expressed her confidence in the youth, stating that young innovators are the true future of Bangladesh.
She pledged that the government would stand by young innovators and technology entrepreneurs to help them scale their ideas into viable businesses.
The MIST team shared their experience and the technical details of their winning project, highlighting the potential of Bangladeshi students on the world stage.
The Prime Minister encouraged the team to continue their research and development, stressing the importance of innovation in achieving a 'Smart Bangladesh'.
caption:
Young innovators are the future of Bangladesh. The PM pledges full support for tech startups after meeting world champion MIST team.

Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina met with the world champion team from the Military Institute of Science and Technology (MIST), celebrating their global achievement in technology.

During the meeting, the Prime Minister expressed her confidence in the youth, stating that young innovators are the true future of Bangladesh.

She pledged that the government would stand by young innovators and technology entrepreneurs to help them scale their ideas into viable businesses.

The MIST team shared their experience and the technical details of their winning project, highlighting the potential of Bangladeshi students on the world stage.

The Prime Minister encouraged the team to continue their research and development, stressing the importance of innovation in achieving a 'Smart Bangladesh'.

#Bangladesh #TechInnovation #MIST #SmartBangladesh #YouthEmpowerment

Source: Somoy News, Prothom Alo, Dhaka Tribune
